        LIMIT 3
    ),

        SELECT

            toYear(f.DateKey) AS sales_year,
            pc.ProductCategoryKey,
            pc.ProductCategoryName,
            sum(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount

        INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps

WITH direct_reports AS (
    SELECT
        toInt32(ParentEmployeeKey) AS ManagerKey,
        count() AS DirectReportCount,
        avgIf(
            dateDiff('day', toDate(HireDate), today()) / 365.25,
            HireDate IS NOT NULL AND HireDate != ''
        ) AS AvgTenureYears
    FROM retail.DimEmployee
    WHERE ParentEmployeeKey IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ManagerKey
)
SELECT
    m.EmployeeKey AS ManagerKey,
    concat(m.FirstName, ' ', m.LastName) AS ManagerName,
    d.DirectReportCount,
    round(d.AvgTenureYears, 2) AS AvgTeamTenureYears
FROM direct_reports d
INNER JOIN retail.DimEmployee m
    ON m.EmployeeKey = d.ManagerKey
ORDER BY d.DirectReportCount DESC, ManagerName
